primary_gate.definition: paired medians over all3 repetitions of warm query+OLD recorded model/softmax, both wall AND CPU versus EVERY mandatory control, all repetitions favorable in both clocks
practical_secondary: native Mosaic sequential/parallel original model-confidence operation
competent fused sparse/layered approximate GPU fp32/fp64 sampling without unused marginals
primary_gate.complete_operation_obligation: positive query gate still requires useful complete real neural trajectory, including compilation/all forwards, on independently frozen inputs; no publication/goal completion follows from this stage

first90_decision: only NEGATIVE if fewer than3 states can meet the necessary comparison with interval_exact; unknown/control errors receive no rejection credit; cannot declare positive

timing.cold: constraint-graph compilation measured once per case and charged equally in decomposed first-query totals, plus fresh method compilation/query; globally prepared CUDA JIT cache, explicit setup recorded
timing.warm: reuse structural graph/method buffers only; rebuild every numeric summary/message/CDF/certificate and sample from the same frozen head with fresh randomness
timing.common_setup: pinned compiler import, byte lexer/class partition and resident CUDA head outside individual query; setup measured separately
timing.jit: one untimed complete operation for BOTH methods per case before measurements, recorded as setup; no latency credit from compilation-order effects
timing.timers: CUDA synchronize immediately before/after operations; perf_counter and process_time; model/softmax clocks only separately labeled projected totals
timing.logging: formatting fractions and JSON journal serialization outside ALL method timers; numeric certificate construction remains charged
timing.validation: independent exact mass/strict JSON/fixed original IDs/model confidence/common commit mask outside ALL timers
timing.concurrency: no other local tests, installs or model work during measured records

source_freeze: runner, protocol and auditor committed together before first measurement
